entries.362368e6ddcb18f3: Various waxes, such as paraffin wax and microcrystalline wax. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥18,727 million, consisting of domestic sales of ¥13,217 million and exports of ¥5,509 million. This also includes sales of purchased imported wax. Although the average selling price rose due to a focus on sales of high value-added products and price revisions, sales volume decreased year on year.

entries.9237415704872da8: Wax and Related Products Manufacturing and Sales Business
entries.cc7049cf7a07398a: Sales of heavy oil. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥935 million. The company is reducing unprofitable transactions, and sales volume fell sharply year on year due to lower production volume accompanying improved wax yields and inventory reduction.
entries.ebd86c5418f1912e: As a specialist wax manufacturer, this is a single-segment business that manufactures, processes and sells petroleum wax, various waxes and heavy oil. The Tokuyama Plant and Research and Development Center (Shunan, Yamaguchi Prefecture) serve as the manufacturing and research and development bases; consolidated subsidiary Techno Wax Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing the company's products, and Nippon Seiro (Thailand) Co., Ltd. in Thailand manufactures and sells various waxes. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥19,776 million.
